INTRODUCTION

A & Associates is a reputable staffing agency with a proven track record in screening and recruiting as well as job placement and career development. With more than ten (10) offices throughout the United States, A & Associates is a company that can be trusted to provide a diverse level of services with excellence, diligence and integrity.

“Quality In Everything We Do” is far more than our mantra, it is our standard!!

Explore a career with A & Associates, one of the leading providers for temporary, temp to-hire, permanent placement services and security guard services.

Unarmed Event Security Officer | College Football

Now Hiring for the 2026 College Football Season at UT!

Location: Austin, TX

Pay: $18.00 per hour

A & Associates is now hiring licensed Level II Security Officers for exciting event opportunities at the Alamodome in San Antonio. Join our team and work college football games, concerts, conventions, and other major events throughout the year.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking for flexible, part time work while gaining experience at one of San Antonio's premier event venues.

Requirements

  • Active Texas Level II Non Commissioned Security License is required before your first shift.
  • Must be at least 18 years old.
  • Must have reliable transportation.
  • Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Must be available to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as events are scheduled.
  • Must maintain a professional appearance and provide excellent customer service.

Responsibilities

  • Provide a safe and secure environment for guests, staff, and performers.
  • Monitor entrances, exits, and designated areas.
  • Verify tickets, credentials, or access permissions when assigned.
  • Assist with crowd management before, during, and after events.
  • Respond appropriately to incidents and emergencies while following client procedures.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors, fellow security staff, and event personnel.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service while representing A & Associates professionally.

Overview

Company Overview:

Kick off your exciting career in Event Security with Allied Universal® Event Services, the go-to leader in crowd management and event staffing. Dive into the action at sports stadiums, concerts, festivals, and convention centers, and thrive on the energy of being where it all happens. Join a lively team that services thousands of venues each year, ensuring safety and fun for everyone. Enjoy the perks of flexible part-time work that fits your lifestyle—ideal for students, retirees, or anyone seeking a dynamic job. We offer job opportunities in event staff, security, and operations. Join our welcoming, collaborative, and innovative team, and benefit from a range of perks depending on your role and hours. At Allied Universal®, every day brings a new adventure. Ready to make your mark in the event industry? Join us and be part of the excitement!

Job Description

Now Hiring Event Security Officers $22/hr. for College Sports Events - (All other events pay $18/hr.)

• Weekly Pay• Paid Training• Flexible Part-Time Schedules• Work Sports, Concerts, Festivals & Special Events

Apply today and be part of the team that keeps every event safe and secure.

Allied Universal® Event Services is looking to hire Event Security. This position is responsible for checking bags, enforcing access control and implementing policies and procedures for the safety of the guests and owners, while providing superior customer service for the best guest experience.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Those duties necessary to meet the minimum requirements of the position. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Assist in all aspects of event day preparation and execution.
  • Allow appropriate entry into each venue, may collect and/or scan tickets, verify wristbands and badges, direct traffic coming in and out of the venue.
  • Screen guests during entry via bag searching, hand wand or metal detector, and ID verification.
  • Protect guests, staff, and venue ownership group assets by watching for security breaches at vital checkpoints.
  • Respond quickly to potential crowd control issues and provide escorts for unruly guests when ejections are warranted.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of the policies, procedures and regulations of different venues, facilities and events.
  • Provide a positive experience for guests as they arrive at your facility entrance, aisle, concourse area or other location
  • Provide guests with helpful directions and/or suggestions that will enhance their entertainment experience.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or experience required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Must have a high school diploma or equivalent.

  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.

  • As a condition of employment, candidate must successfully complete a background investigation and a post-offer/pre-employment drug/alcohol test; additional screening may be required if driving a customer or company owned vehicle.
  • Able to use good independent judgment and discretion.
  • Must be able to work overtime as needed.
  • Outstanding oral and written communication skills.

PERKS AND BENEFITS:

  • Part-time flexible scheduling under 30 hours/week that fit with your personal life goals
  • 401(k)
  • Sick Pay
  • Ongoing paid training programs and career growth opportunities
  • Employee discounts through our perks program to your favorite restaurants, entertainment venues, and much more!

jobs.title: Security Guard
jobs.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic security team as a Security Guard and play a vital role in safeguarding our facilities, personnel, and assets. This energetic position requires vigilance, quick thinking, and a commitment to maintaining a safe environment. You will be responsible for monitoring premises through surveillance systems, conducting patrols, managing access control, and responding promptly to emergencies. Your proactive approach will ensure the safety and security of everyone on site while providing excellent customer service to visitors and staff alike.

Duties

  • Conduct regular patrols of the premises to identify potential security risks or breaches.
  • Monitor surveillance equipment such as CCTV cameras to oversee all activity within and around the facility.
  • Control access points using advanced access control systems, verifying identities and authorizations for employees, visitors, contractors, and vendors.
  • Respond swiftly to incidents or emergencies by following established protocols, including fire safety procedures and emergency response plans.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security breaches, accidents, or unusual activities observed during shifts.
  • Perform background checks on new personnel or visitors when required to ensure compliance with security regulations.
  • Utilize conflict management skills to de-escalate tense situations calmly and professionally while maintaining safety for all parties involved.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in physical security, law enforcement, military service, or related fields is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of surveillance technology such as CCTV systems and access control systems.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks including heavy lifting when necessary for patrol equipment or emergency situations.
  • Certification in first aid, CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation), AED (Automated External Defibrillator) operation, and fire safety procedures is preferred.
  • Familiarity with incident report writing and emergency response procedures to ensure accurate documentation and swift action.
  • Skills in conflict de-escalation, conflict management, and law enforcement collaboration to handle challenging situations effectively.
  • Physical fitness to perform patrols, stand for extended periods, and conduct heavy lifting if required.
  • Strong communication skills combined with excellent customer service abilities to interact professionally with staff and visitors while maintaining security standards.

Join us in creating a secure environment where safety is our top priority! We are committed to supporting your growth through comprehensive training opportunities and a vibrant team culture dedicated to excellence in security operations.

Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
